blocks.text: Ikki narsani yoki bir narsaning avvalgi va hozirgi holatini taqqoslaganda sifat **qiyosiy darajada** (comparative) ishlatiladi. O'zbek tilida buning uchun `-roq` qo'shimchasi bor: arzon → arzon**roq**, qimmat → qimmat**roq**. Ingliz tilida esa ikki yo'l bor: qisqa sifatga `-er` qo'shiladi (cheap → cheap**er**), uzun sifat oldiga **more** qo'yiladi (expensive → **more** expensive). Qaysi yo'l tanlanishi sifatning uzunligiga — bo'g'inlar soniga bog'liq.

Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar `-er` oladi: old, young, cheap, fast, long, short, tall, small, warm, cold, clean → older, younger, cheaper, faster ... `-y` bilan tugagan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar ham `-er` oladi, faqat `y` → `i` ga o'zgaradi: easy → easier, happy → happier, busy → busier, heavy → heavier, early → earlier. Bunday so'zlar qisqa eshitiladi, shuning uchun qo'shimcha ularga bemalol qo'shiladi.

items.text: Your bag is heavy, but mine is **heavier**.

blocks.text: Yozishda uchta qoida bor. (1) `-e` bilan tugasa, faqat `-r` qo'shiladi: nice → nice**r**, late → late**r**, large → large**r**. (2) Undoshdan keyingi `-y` → `-ier`: happy → happ**ier**, dry → dr**ier**. (3) So'z «bitta unli + bitta undosh» bilan tugasa, oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: big → bi**gg**er, hot → ho**tt**er, thin → thi**nn**er, wet → we**tt**er, sad → sa**dd**er. Ikki unli (cheap → cheaper, cool → cooler) yoki ikki undosh (cold → colder, fast → faster) bo'lsa, ikkilanmaydi; `w` ham ikkilanmaydi (new → newer, slow → slower).

rows: cheap → cheap**er**, cold → cold**er**, new → new**er**
nice → nice**r**, safe → safe**r**, late → late**r**
easy → eas**ier**, busy → bus**ier**, funny → funn**ier**
big → bi**gg**er, hot → ho**tt**er, thin → thi**nn**er

blocks.text: Ikki bo'g'inli (`-y` bilan tugaganlardan tashqari) va undan uzun sifatlar `-er` olmaydi — ularning oldiga **more** qo'yiladi: **more** expensive, **more** interesting, **more** comfortable, **more** dangerous, **more** famous, **more** modern, **more** careful, **more** boring. Uzun so'zga yana bir bo'g'in qo'shilsa, talaffuz og'irlashadi — shuning uchun «expensiver» deyilmaydi. `-ly` bilan tugagan ravishlar ham **more** oladi: **more** slowly, **more** carefully. Ba'zi ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar ikkala shaklda ham ishlatiladi: quiet → quieter / more quiet, clever → cleverer / more clever, simple → simpler / more simple.

items.text: The museum is **more interesting** with a guide.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: `-er` va **more** birga ishlatilmaydi: «more cheaper» → **cheaper**, «more better» → **better**; uzun sifatga `-er` qo'shilmaydi: «expensiver», «beautifuler» → **more expensive**, **more beautiful**; noto'g'ri shakllar: «gooder», «badder» → **better**, **worse**; yozilish: «biger», «easyer» → **bigger**, **easier**.

Uchta so'z qiyosiy darajani butunlay boshqa shaklda yasaydi — ularni yod olish kerak. **good** (sifat) va **well** (ravish) — ikkalasi ham **better**: a **better** idea, she sings **better**. **bad** va **badly** — **worse**: The weather is **worse** today. **far** (uzoq) — **further** yoki **farther**; British English'da **further** ko'proq ishlatiladi. I feel **better** — kasallikdan keyin «tuzukroqman, tuzalyapman» degani.

items.text: I don't like this café. Let's find a **better** one.
The hotel is a bit **further** along this road.

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: bitta bo'g'in → `-er` (cheap**er**); `-y` → `-ier` (eas**ier**); uzun so'z → **more** (more expensive); good / bad / far — yod oling: **better**, **worse**, **further**.

Taqqoslanayotgan narsa **than** bilan qo'shiladi: older **than** me — 88-dars. as ... as («... dek») — 89-dars; orttirma daraja (the oldest, the most expensive) — 90-dars. Sifat va ravishning o'zi — 85–86-darslar.

examples.title: **-er**: **cheaper**, **longer**, **faster**
examples.description: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga `-er` qo'shiladi: cheap → **cheaper**, fast → **faster**. O'zbekchadagi `-roq` ga o'xshaydi: arzon → **arzonroq**.

sentences.text: Let's take the bus. It's **cheaper**.
This box is heavy. Is the other one **lighter**?
Can you speak a bit **louder**? I can't hear you.
In June the days get **longer** and the nights get **shorter**.
Our old car was slow — the new one is **faster**.
James wants a **smaller** flat near his office.
Is it **warmer** in Samarkand today?
The road through the mountains is **shorter**, but it's dangerous in winter.
sentences.translation: Tog' orqali o'tadigan yo'l **qisqaroq**, lekin qishda xavfli.

sentences.text: After the rain the air felt **cleaner** and **fresher**.
My grandfather is eighty, but he feels **younger** when his grandchildren visit him.
sentences.translation: Bobom sakson yoshda, lekin nevaralari kelganda o'zini **yoshroq** his qiladi.

examples.title: Spelling: **bigger**, **nicer**, **easier**
examples.description: Yozilishi: `-e` → `-r` (nice → **nicer**); `-y` → `-ier` (easy → **easier**); bitta unli + bitta undosh — undosh ikkilanadi (big → **bigger**, hot → **hotter**).

sentences.text: Your new flat is **bigger** and **nicer**.
Today is **hotter** — let's go to the lake.
The second test was **easier**, so everybody passed.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi test **osonroq** edi, shuning uchun hamma o'tdi.

sentences.text: After the holiday the children looked **happier** and **healthier**.
Bekzod is **thinner** now — he goes to the gym every day.
sentences.translation: Bekzod endi **ozg'inroq** — har kuni sport zaliga boradi.

sentences.text: This month I'm **busier** at work, so I can't come.
sentences.translation: Bu oy ishda **bandroqman**, shuning uchun kela olmayman.

sentences.text: Could we meet a bit **later**, at seven?
In November the weather in Manchester gets **wetter** and **windier**.
We need a **larger** table — twelve people are coming for dinner.
sentences.translation: Bizga **kattaroq** stol kerak — kechki ovqatga o'n ikki kishi keladi.

sentences.text: Tom's jokes are getting **funnier**, but his stories are getting **longer**!
sentences.translation: Tomning hazillari **kulgiliroq**, hikoyalari esa **uzunroq** bo'lib boryapti!

examples.title: **more** + long adjectives: **more expensive**
examples.description: Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar (`-y` bilan tugaganlardan tashqari) **more** bilan: expensive → **more expensive**, interesting → **more interesting**. «Expensiver» degan shakl yo'q.

sentences.text: Taxis are **more expensive** in the evening.
The second part of the film was **more interesting**.
Can we find a **more comfortable** hotel next time?
Driving in winter is **more dangerous**, so be careful.
sentences.translation: Qishda mashina haydash **xavfliroq**, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: Our new manager is **more relaxed** about working hours.
Grammar is important, but speaking is **more important** for me.
sentences.translation: Grammatika muhim, lekin men uchun gapirish **muhimroq**.

sentences.text: Which language is **more difficult** for you, Russian or English?
sentences.translation: Siz uchun qaysi til **qiyinroq** — rus tilimi yoki ingliz tili?

sentences.text: After a few lessons Aziz became **more confident** at speaking.
sentences.translation: Bir necha darsdan keyin Aziz gapirishda **o'ziga ishonchliroq** bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: Samarkand gets **more beautiful** every year.
The modern part of Tashkent is **more crowded**, but the old part is **more charming**.
sentences.translation: Toshkentning zamonaviy qismi **gavjumroq**, eski qismi esa **jozibaliroq**.

examples.title: Irregular: **better**, **worse**, **further**
examples.description: Noto'g'ri shakllar: good / well → **better**, bad / badly → **worse**, far → **further** (yoki farther). «Gooder», «more good», «badder» degan shakllar yo'q.

sentences.text: I had a cold yesterday, but I feel **better** today.
The traffic is **worse** on Fridays.
Your English is getting **better** and **better**!
Which is **further** from Tashkent, Bukhara or Khiva? — Khiva.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan qaysi biri **uzoqroq** — Buxoromi yoki Xiva? — Xiva.

sentences.text: The first hotel was bad, but the second one was even **worse**.
sentences.translation: Birinchi mehmonxona yomon edi, ikkinchisi esa undan ham **battar** chiqdi.

sentences.text: Let's walk a bit **further** — there's a nice café by the river.
sentences.translation: Yana biroz **nariroq** yuraylik — daryo bo'yida yaxshi kafe bor.

sentences.text: Emma plays tennis **better** now because she trains every day.
sentences.translation: Emma endi tennisni **yaxshiroq** o'ynaydi, chunki har kuni mashq qiladi.

sentences.text: My eyes are getting **worse**, so I need new glasses.
Do you know a **better** way to the airport? — Yes, take the ring road.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga **yaxshiroq** yo'lni bilasizmi? — Ha, halqa yo'ldan yuring.

sentences.text: For students, a cheap phone with a good camera is often a **better** choice.
sentences.translation: Talabalar uchun yaxshi kamerali arzon telefon ko'pincha **yaxshiroq** tanlov.

examples.title: Adverbs: **faster**, **earlier**, **more slowly**
examples.description: Ravishlar ham qiyosiy daraja oladi: fast → **faster**, hard → **harder**, early → **earlier**; `-ly` bilan tugaganlar — **more**: **more slowly**, **more carefully**. well → **better**, badly → **worse**.

sentences.text: Could you speak **more clearly**, please? The line is bad.
You need to work **harder** before the exam.
Tomorrow we have to get up **earlier** — the train leaves at six.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **ertaroq** turishimiz kerak — poyezd soat oltida jo'naydi.

sentences.text: Drive **more carefully** — there are children near the school.
Dilnoza runs **faster** every week.
Please come a bit **later** — I'm still cooking.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, biroz **kechroq** keling — hali ovqat pishiryapman.

sentences.text: Since his operation, Grandad has to walk **more slowly** and rest **more often**.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin bobom **sekinroq** yurishi va **ko'proq** dam olishi kerak.

sentences.text: James explained it again, and this time I understood **better**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yana bir bor tushuntirdi, bu safar **yaxshiroq** tushundim.

sentences.text: Our team played **worse** in the second half.
In the new office the internet works **more quickly**, so we finish our work **sooner**.
sentences.translation: Yangi ofisda internet **tezroq** ishlaydi, shuning uchun ishni **ertaroq** tugatamiz.

examples.title: Which is **cheaper**? — questions and answers
examples.description: Ikki narsadan birini tanlash: **Which is cheaper**, ...? **Who is taller**, ...? — qisqa javob bilan. O'zbekchada: «Qaysi biri arzonroq?»

sentences.text: Which is **cheaper**, the bus or the metro? — The metro.
sentences.translation: Qaysi biri **arzonroq**, avtobusmi yoki metro? — Metro.

sentences.text: Which room is **quieter**? — The one at the back.
Which looks **nicer** on me, the blue dress or the red one? — The red one, definitely.
sentences.translation: Qaysi biri menga **yarashiqliroq**, ko'k ko'ylakmi yoki qizil? — Albatta, qizili.

sentences.text: Who is **taller**, you or your brother? — My brother is.
Is your new job **better**? — Yes, and the money is **better** too.
Are the shops **busier** at the weekend? — Yes, especially on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari do'konlar **gavjumroq** bo'ladimi? — Ha, ayniqsa shanba kuni.

sentences.text: Who is **older**, Madina or her cousin? — Madina is, by two years.
sentences.translation: Kim **kattaroq**, Madinami yoki amakivachchasimi? — Madina, ikki yoshga.

sentences.text: Was the second hotel **more comfortable**? — No, it was worse.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi mehmonxona **qulayroq** edimi? — Yo'q, battar edi.

sentences.text: Would a small car be **more practical** in the city? — Yes, and it's easier to park.
sentences.translation: Shaharda kichik mashina **qulayroq** bo'larmidi? — Ha, uni joylashtirish ham osonroq.

sentences.text: Do you think online lessons are **more useful**? — Not really, I prefer a real classroom.
sentences.translation: Onlayn darslar **foydaliroq** deb o'ylaysizmi? — Unchalik emas, men haqiqiy sinfxonani afzal ko'raman.

examples.title: Changes: **getting colder**, **cheaper** then
examples.description: Narsa o'zgarganda — **get** + qiyosiy daraja: It's **getting colder** (sovib boryapti). Avvalgi va hozirgi holat taqqoslanadi.

sentences.text: It's **getting colder** — winter is coming.
Prices in the market are **getting higher** every month.
When I was a child, the city was **smaller** and **greener**.
Now the streets are **wider**, but the traffic is **heavier**.
Tom is **getting older**, and he looks **more** like his father every year.
sentences.translation: Tom **ulg'ayib** boryapti, har yili otasiga **ko'proq** o'xshayapti.

sentences.text: Phones are **thinner** and **lighter** now, but they're **more expensive**.
The days are **getting shorter**, so we have dinner **earlier**.
sentences.translation: Kunlar **qisqarib** boryapti, shuning uchun kechki ovqatni **ertaroq** qilamiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod's English was weak last year, but it's **better** now.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Bekzodning inglizchasi bo'sh edi, hozir esa **yaxshiroq**.

sentences.text: Ten years ago flights to London were **cheaper**, and there were fewer rules.
sentences.translation: O'n yil oldin Londonga reyslar **arzonroq** edi, qoidalar ham kamroq edi.

sentences.text: Our grandparents' lives were **harder**, but they say people were **friendlier** then.
sentences.translation: Bobo-buvilarimizning hayoti **og'irroq** edi, lekin o'shanda odamlar **samimiyroq** bo'lgan, deyishadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: which phone is **better**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki telefonni taqqoslash — `-er` (**cheaper**, **bigger**), **more** (**more expensive**) va **better**.

sentences.text: — I can't decide between these two phones. Which one is **better**?
sentences.translation: — Shu ikki telefondan birini tanlay olmayapman. Qaysi biri **yaxshiroq**?

sentences.text: — Well, the black one is **newer**, and the camera is **better**.
— Yes, but it's **more expensive**. The silver one is **cheaper**.
— Is the silver one **lighter** as well?
— A little, and the screen is **bigger**, so it's **easier** to read.
sentences.translation: — Sal-pal, ekrani ham **kattaroq**, shuning uchun o'qish **osonroq**.

sentences.text: — And the battery? I need a **stronger** one — mine dies by lunchtime.
sentences.translation: — Batareyasi-chi? Menga **kuchliroq** batareya kerak — meniki tushlikkacha o'tirib qoladi.

sentences.text: — The black one lasts **longer**, but it charges **more slowly**.
— Hmm. The silver one sounds **more sensible** for me.
— Good choice. And you can buy a **nicer** case with the money you save.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi tanlov. Tejagan pulingizga **chiroyliroq** g'ilof ham olasiz.

sentences.text: — Great, that makes things **simpler**. I'll take it!
